items.title: Geometric reducedness of the generic fibre spreads to all fibres over a dense open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base, geometric reducedness of the fibre over the generic point forces geometric reducedness of every fibre over a nonempty open. The proof reduces to the affine situation, expresses geometric reducedness of the generic fibre by the absence of nilpotents after base change to the algebraic closure, and then spreads that condition to a neighbourhood using finite presentation. Producing a witness that survives the base change to the algebraic closure and then to the spread is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7227-7256.
